claim_limit: Exposed development comparison of hard masking and one fixed 0.25 row x block removal step under Ridge. Exact grouped query gain evaluates cohorts selected and risk-guarded using exposed feedback on a disjoint support fold; the B=0/1/2/4 curves treat each exposed Source as a target-only diagnostic and do not open the UCI Target. singleton credits are never summed as policy value. Proxy magnitudes are not averaged across datasets as intrinsic data value. This is not Capability, Promotion, Memory, or transfer evidence.

cohort_risk_guard_rule.direction_decision: EXECUTE iff exact grouped support gain > 0
guarded_headroom: at least 2 of 4 guarded dataset means > 0

configuration.all_rows_guard: if all 72 rows are selected for a block, retain the row with minimum support credit; ties use lower row index
configuration.cohort_risk_guard: execute the proxy-guided four-block cohort iff its exact grouped support gain > 0; otherwise abstain and keep the clean Ridge baseline
configuration.empty_group_rule: keep the clean Ridge baseline for that block
configuration.metric: per-series sMASE, equal mean within alternating 4/4 fold
configuration.oracle_diagnostic_rule: per block select rows with support-fold exact singleton credit > 0
configuration.proxy_selection_rule: per block select rows with support-fold singleton first-order credit > 0
configuration.soft_typed_program: downweight selected training rows from 1.0 to 0.75 for each selected 12-step output block
configuration.typed_program: mask one training row from the Ridge loss for one 12-step output block

support_query_splits.B=0: no support; one baseline query over all 8 series
support_query_splits.B=1: 8 singleton supports; query is the other 7 series
support_query_splits.B=2: 4 fixed disjoint supports (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7); query is the other 6 series
support_query_splits.B=4: 2 alternating supports (0,2,4,6) and (1,3,5,7); query is the complementary 4 series
